item.title: [ZEPPELIN-5572] Deadlock found when send 'GET_NOTE' OP message
item.description:
org.apache.zeppelin.socket.ConnectionManager#addNoteConnection   deadlock at 

'synchronized (noteSocketMap)'

 

Zeppelin occasionally fails to respond when click paragraph or refresh notebook page, but other functions such as login and configuration are normal. 
 
This phenomenon has appeared for the third time, and you must to restart it to restore service.

 

Test it by remote debug and jstack log found that deadlock occur when addNoteConnection method, see more jstack log in attachments please.

 

Note: I used the remote debugging on this instance some time ago. I am not sure weather it caused by one of the debugging connections disconnect then cause incompletable request.

alex09  ZEPPELIN-5343 is fixed in 0.9.1 and 0.10.0, but 0.9.1 is never released, so the only release you can try is after 0.10.x

zjffdu   We have merged the change code in  ZEPPELIN-5343 on our branch (based 0.9.0), already fix the specific issue.

 

We think the issue posted above is a deadlock caused by another problem. I hope you can check the stack log and judge whether my description is correct when you have time. Thank you very much.

 

Thread qtp597255128-202765 lock 0x00000001498490b8, 0x000000011a892520 in sequence. Thread qtp597255128-202273 lock 0x000000011a892520, 0x00000001498490b8 in sequence. This is a cycle.

 

The thread stack show we have changed the code, use `sendStringByFuture` instead of `sendString`. Obviously, it has nothing to do with ZEPPELIN-5343 .

 

org.eclipse.jetty.websocket.common.WebSocketRemoteEndpoint.sendStringByFuture(WebSocketRemoteEndpoint.java:403)

zjffdu 

SOME CONCLUSION:

  1. Deadlock occurs when the socket request encountered an error, see thread dump `at org.eclipse.jetty.util.IteratingCallback.failed(IteratingCallback.java:402)`. At this time, the processing thread will jump to method NotebookSocket.onWebSocketClose(), then call ConnectionManager.broadcast(). In method broadcast() will lock noteSocketMap, then lock conn in noteSocketMap.get(noteId).
  2. Different OP method in NotebookServer#onMessage lock obj in different sequence, like Thread A execute getNote() lock noteSocketMap,  Thread B execute getInterpreterBindings() lock connX.
  3. If both processing thread occurs exception in (1), and the ConnectionManager is the same one, Thread A will lock noteSocketMap, then try to lock connX, connY... Thread B will try to lock noteSocketMap. A deadlock appears.

 

Maybe there is no need to lock noteSocketMap in onWebSocketClose() stack?

Got the same problem as alex09 describe.

When org.eclipse.jetty.util.IteratingCallback.failed it cause deadlock like a circle.

alex09 Have you solved this problem?   

the stack trace of method onOutputUpdated in thread 1: the method will lock socket to send message, but error may occur here and then will enter websocket close method , and then to lock noteSocketMap, then acquire the lock socket again.

aother thread 2: lock noteSocketMap, and then lock socket

if thread 1 locked socket and waiting to lock noteSocketMap, and thread 2 locked noteSocketMap and waiting to lock socket, the deadlock may occur.

vmaster We have solved this problem in 0.9.x

 

We modify the `NotebookSocket.send()` method
Before:
connection.getRemote().sendString(serializeMessage);

After:
connection.getRemote().sendStringByFuture(serializeMessage);
 

And we give `PooledRemoteClient` a bigger pool size, default is 8.
